nuance: A polite phrase used when someone is going to bed in order to rest.

examples.ja: {息子|むすこ}が{母|はは}に：「お{母|かあ}さん、**お{休|やす}みなさい**。」
examples.en: Son to his mother: 'Good night mom.'
examples.audio: https://dk3kgylsgq3k1.cloudfront.net/audio/vocab/tts/息子が母に：「お母さん、お休みなさい。」-female.mp3

examples.ja: {娘|むすめ}：「もう{眠|ねむ}いよ…**お{休|やす}みなさい**〜。」
examples.en: Daughter: 'I am already tired... Good night.'

examples.ja: {父|ちち}が{娘|むすめ}に：「ぐっすり{寝|ね}てね、**お{休|やす}みなさい**。」
examples.en: Father to his daughter: 'Sleep well, good night.
examples.audio: https://dk3kgylsgq3k1.cloudfront.net/audio/vocab/tts/父が娘に：「ぐっすり寝てね、お休みなさい。」-female.mp3

examples.ja: 「{明日|あした}は{早|はや}く{起|お}きなくてはいけないから、もう{寝|ね}るね。**お{休|やす}みなさい**。」
examples.en: 'Since I have to get up early tomorrow, I'll go to sleep already. Good night.'
examples.audio: https://dk3kgylsgq3k1.cloudfront.net/audio/vocab/tts/「明日は早く起きなくてはいけないから、もう寝るね。お休みなさい。」-female.mp3

nuance: A polite word to highlight the act of speaking to God.

examples.ja: **お{祈|いの}り**をサボる。
examples.en: I will skip out on prayer.
examples.audio: https://dk3kgylsgq3k1.cloudfront.net/audio/vocab/tts/お祈りをサボる。-female.mp3

examples.ja: メッカの{聖堂|せいどう}に{向|む}かって**お{祈|いの}り**をする。
examples.en: To pray facing the temple at Mecca.

examples.ja: {神様|かみさま}に**お{祈|いの}り**をする。
examples.en: To make a prayer to God.
examples.audio: https://dk3kgylsgq3k1.cloudfront.net/audio/vocab/tts/神様にお祈りをする。-female.mp3

examples.ja: {私|わたし}は{無宗教|むしゅうきょう}だから**お{祈|いの}り**をしません。
examples.en: Because I am not religious, I do not pray.

examples.ja: {私|わたし}たちの{家族|かぞく}は{夕食前|ゆうしょくまえ}に**お{祈|いの}り**をする{習慣|しゅうかん}があります。
examples.en: Our family has the tradition of saying a prayer before our evening meal.
examples.audio: https://dk3kgylsgq3k1.cloudfront.net/audio/vocab/tts/私たちの家族は夕食前にお祈りをする習慣があります。-female.mp3

examples.ja: **お{祈|いの}り**をしたおかげで、{願|ねが}いがようやく{叶|かな}いました。
examples.en: Thanks to praying, my wish finally came true.

meaning: my sympathies, that's too bad, my condolences
nuance: A polite phrase used in order to express sympathy, often for another's loss.

examples.ja: 「{足|あし}を{折|お}っちゃった。」「**お{気|き}の{毒|どく}に**。」
examples.en: 'I broke my foot.' 'I'm sorry to hear that.'
examples.audio: https://dk3kgylsgq3k1.cloudfront.net/audio/vocab/tts/「足を折っちゃった。」「お気の毒に。」-female.mp3

examples.ja: 「{宝物|たからもの}を{失|な}くした…」「それは**お{気|き}の{毒|どく}に**。」
examples.en: 'I lost the treasure...' 'I'm sorry to hear that.'
examples.audio: https://dk3kgylsgq3k1.cloudfront.net/audio/vocab/tts/「宝物を失くした…」「それはお気の毒に。」-female.mp3

examples.ja: 「{貴女|あなた}の{家|いえ}が{火事|かじ}になったらしいですね。**お{気|き}の{毒|どく}に**…。」
examples.en: 'I heard that your house was in a fire. I'm sorry to hear that.'
examples.audio: https://dk3kgylsgq3k1.cloudfront.net/audio/vocab/tts/「貴女の家が火事になったらしいですね。お気の毒に…。」-female.mp3

nuance: The removal of something from within another thing. Often used in relation to money.

examples.ja: **お{引|ひ}き{出|だ}し**をしたので{口座|こうざ}{残高|ざんだか}が{減|へ}りました。
examples.en: Because I made a withdrawal, my account balance reduced.
examples.audio: https://dk3kgylsgq3k1.cloudfront.net/audio/vocab/tts/お引き出しをしたので口座残高が減りました。-female.mp3

examples.audio: https://dk3kgylsgq3k1.cloudfront.net/audio/vocab/tts/現金を用意するためにATMでお引き出しをする。-female.mp3

examples.ja: {一回|いっかい}の**おひきだし**の{上限|じょうげん}{金額|きんがく}はいくらですか？
examples.en: What is the upper limit for a single cash withdrawal?
examples.audio: https://dk3kgylsgq3k1.cloudfront.net/audio/vocab/tts/一回のお引き出しの上限金額はいくらですか？-female.mp3

meaning: onigiri, rice ball (often triangular, sometimes with a filling and wrapped in nori)
nuance: A palm-sized rice ball that often contains some kind of meat or vegetable. May be wrapped in seaweed.

examples.ja: {私|わたし}は{母|はは}の{作|つく}る**おにぎり**が{大好|だいす}きです。
examples.en: I love the onigiri that my mom makes.
examples.audio: https://dk3kgylsgq3k1.cloudfront.net/audio/vocab/tts/私は母の作るおにぎりが大好きです。-female.mp3

examples.ja: **おにぎり**に{梅|うめ}は{入|い}れないでください。
examples.en: Please don't put plum in the rice balls.

nuance: A term used to refer to women of around middle age that may or may not be related to one by blood.

examples.audio: https://dk3kgylsgq3k1.cloudfront.net/audio/vocab/tts/久しぶりにおばさんに会う。-female.mp3

examples.ja: **おばさん**は{元気|げんき}ですか？
examples.en: Is aunty doing well?

examples.en: I think I shall eat parfait with aunty next time.
examples.audio: https://dk3kgylsgq3k1.cloudfront.net/audio/vocab/tts/今度おばさんとパフェを食べようと思う。-female.mp3

meaning: uncle, old man, mister, manybar goatfish (Parupeneus multifasciatus)
nuance: A term used to refer to men of around middle age that may or may not be related to one by blood.

examples.ja: {近所|きんじょ}の**おじさん**と{話|はな}す。
examples.en: I will talk with the neighborhood old man.
examples.audio: https://dk3kgylsgq3k1.cloudfront.net/audio/vocab/tts/近所のおじさんと話す。-female.mp3

examples.en: 'Sir, is this wallet yours?'
examples.audio: https://dk3kgylsgq3k1.cloudfront.net/audio/vocab/tts/「おじさん、この財布おじさんの？」-female.mp3

examples.ja: {母|はは}が{息子|むすこ}に：「**おじさん**に{水|みず}を{出|だ}してあげなさい。」
examples.en: Mother to her son: 'Please take out some water and give it to your uncle.'
examples.audio: https://dk3kgylsgq3k1.cloudfront.net/audio/vocab/tts/母が息子に：「おじさんに水を出してあげなさい。」-female.mp3

meaning: so much, so often, so long, particularly, especially, oh, yes!, that's it, I remember, that's right, quite, indeed
nuance: An expression that is used to confirm or agree with a statement, often in an enthusiastic manner.

examples.ja: 「あなたの{娘|むすめ}は{医者|いしゃ}ですか？」「**そうそう**。」
examples.en: 'Is your daughter a doctor?' 'Yeah yeah, that's right.'
examples.audio: https://dk3kgylsgq3k1.cloudfront.net/audio/vocab/tts/「あなたの娘は医者ですか？」「そうそう。」-female.mp3

examples.ja: 「あ、**そうそう**。あなたのお{父|とう}さんを{駅|えき}で{見|み}たよ。」
examples.en: 'Oh, that's right. I saw your dad at the station.'
examples.audio: https://dk3kgylsgq3k1.cloudfront.net/audio/vocab/tts/「あ、そうそう。あなたのお父さんを駅で見たよ。」-female.mp3

examples.ja: {生|い}きていたら、**そうそう**{楽|たの}しいことばかりではない。
examples.en: Even if you're alive, it's not going to be particularly fun all the time.

nuance: The act of becoming lost or disoriented while trying to find a specific location.

examples.en: I was walking without thinking and got lost.
examples.audio: https://dk3kgylsgq3k1.cloudfront.net/audio/vocab/tts/何も考えずに歩いていたら道に迷ってしまいました。-female.mp3

examples.ja: {小|ちい}さな{男|おとこ}の{子|こ}が**{道|みち}に{迷|まよ}**っているようなので{声|こえ}を{掛|か}けてあげよう。
examples.en: A little boy seems to be lost, so let's talk to him.
examples.audio: https://dk3kgylsgq3k1.cloudfront.net/audio/vocab/tts/小さな男の子が道に迷っているようなので声を掛けてあげよう。-female.mp3

examples.en: Asking someone: 'Hey, where are you from? Where are your mom and dad? Are you lost?'

meaning: etc., otherwise, besides, in addition, the rest, the others, and so forth
nuance: An expression used to refer to additional things or people not previously mentioned.

examples.ja: メイン{料理|りょうり}と**その{他|ほか}**を{合|あ}わせて{一|いち}{万|まん}{円|えん}です。

examples.ja: {打|う}ち{合|あ}わせと**その{他|ほか}**の{撮影|さつえい}で{時間|じかん}が{長引|ながび}いてすみません。
examples.en: Sorry for the time dragging on with the briefing and the rest of the shooting.

meaning: how, in what way, how about, questionable
nuance: The polite version of a common word used for asking about unknown objects or in polite enquiries.

examples.en: Waitress: 'How about some water?'
examples.audio: https://dk3kgylsgq3k1.cloudfront.net/audio/vocab/tts/ウエイトレス：「お水はいかがですか？」-female.mp3

examples.ja: {体調|たいちょう}は**いかが**？
examples.en: How is your health?
examples.audio: https://dk3kgylsgq3k1.cloudfront.net/audio/vocab/tts/体調はいかが？-female.mp3

examples.audio: https://dk3kgylsgq3k1.cloudfront.net/audio/vocab/tts/甘いものでもいかがですか？このドーナツがオススメです。-female.mp3

meaning: pleased to meet you, how do you do, my regards (to someone), my greetings, best wishes, remember me to
nuance: A polite phrase that is often used as an introduction when meeting someone for the first time.

examples.ja: 「サイトウです、**どうぞ{宜|よろ}しく**。」
examples.en: 'I'm Saitou. Pleased to meet you.'
examples.audio: https://dk3kgylsgq3k1.cloudfront.net/audio/vocab/tts/「サイトウです、どうぞ宜しく。」-female.mp3

examples.ja: 「{医師|いし}のタナカだ。**どうぞ{宜|よろ}しく**。」
examples.en: I am doctor Tanaka. Pleased to meet you.'
examples.audio: https://dk3kgylsgq3k1.cloudfront.net/audio/vocab/tts/「医師のタナカだ。どうぞ宜しく。」-female.mp3

examples.ja: 「{今日|きょう}からこのクラスを{担当|たんとう}するイシザキです。**どうぞ{宜|よろ}しく**お{願|ねが}いします。」

meaning: to insult, to say something insulting about, to bad-mouth
nuance: An expression indicating the act of making negative or hurtful comments about someone.

examples.audio: https://dk3kgylsgq3k1.cloudfront.net/audio/vocab/tts/悪口を言うのはやめよう。-female.mp3

examples.ja: なんで{彼女|かのじょ}の**{悪口|わるぐち}を{言|い}う**のですか？
examples.en: Why do you speak ill of her?
examples.audio: https://dk3kgylsgq3k1.cloudfront.net/audio/vocab/tts/なんで彼女の悪口を言うのですか？-female.mp3

examples.ja: {先生|せんせい}：「{同級生|どうきゅうせい}の**{悪口|わるぐち}を{言|い}う**のはやめなさい！」
examples.en: Teacher: 'Stop talking bad about your classmates!'
examples.audio: https://dk3kgylsgq3k1.cloudfront.net/audio/vocab/tts/先生：「同級生の悪口を言うのはやめなさい！」-female.mp3

meaning: if you don't mind, if you like
nuance: An even more polite way of saying 'if it's okay' or 'if it's acceptable'.

examples.ja: **{宜|よろ}しかったら**ご{飯|はん}を{一緒|いっしょ}に{食|た}べましょう。

examples.ja: ナンパする：「お{姉|ねえ}さん、もし{僕|ぼく}で**{宜|よろ}しかったら**この{後|あと}{素敵|すてき}なイタリアンでも{一緒|いっしょ}にどうですか？」
examples.en: Hitting on someone: 'Hey, miss, if you're okay with me, would you like to grab some nice Italian food together after this?'
examples.audio: https://dk3kgylsgq3k1.cloudfront.net/audio/vocab/tts/ナンパする：「お姉さん、もし僕で宜しかったらこの後素敵なイタリアンでも一緒にどうですか？」-female.mp3

examples.en: Reporter: 'Prime Minister, if you don't mind, could you be a little more specific about your future policy strategy?'
examples.audio: https://dk3kgylsgq3k1.cloudfront.net/audio/vocab/tts/記者：「総理大臣、宜しかったら今後の政策の戦略について少し具体的なお話を頂けませんでしょうか？」-female.mp3

meaning: take care, take good care of yourself

examples.en: I hope you always remain well from now!

examples.ja: あまり{体調|たいちょう}の{優|すぐ}れない{祖父|そふ}に「**{元気|げんき}でね**。」と{手紙|てがみ}を{書|か}きました。

examples.ja: {金庫|きんこ}の**{鍵|かぎ}をかける**のを{忘|わす}れてすみません。{以後|いご}{気|き}をつけます。
